components.name: scrcpy client and server
components.notes: Official v5.0.1 Windows x64 archive SHA-256 matched upstream's published hash; no published scrcpy advisory. Release replaces the 4.1 bundle and updates its native libraries.

components.name: Android SDK Platform-Tools (ADB)
components.notes: Google's 37.0.1 release notes reviewed; bundled adb.exe hash matches the official Windows Platform-Tools archive.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.notes: Updated from 8.1.2 after reviewing 2026 FFmpeg CVEs. Scrcpy's verified 9.0.2 build disables network, Vulkan, and all components by default, then enables only selected raw video/audio decoders, image2 demuxer, local file protocol, and output muxers. Reported SFTP, RTSP, HLS, DASH, MOV input, Vulkan HEVC, and metadata remuxing issues (including CVE-2026-64831 and CVE-2026-107675/107676/107677/107678/107696) are outside the enabled input and network paths; continue monitoring for fixes affecting enabled decoders.

components.name: dav1d
components.notes: Version 1.5.4 is identified in the official scrcpy 5.0.1 release. No applicable advisory was found in the available upstream release information; the VideoLAN security page was unavailable during this review.

components.name: SDL
components.notes: Current upstream stable 3.4.18 release and published advisory list reviewed; no published SDL advisory.

components.name: libusb
components.notes: Upstream 1.0.30 release and advisory list reviewed; this release includes the descriptor parsing fix for CVE-2026-23679.

components.name: zlib
components.notes: Upstream 1.3.2 release and security changes reviewed. zlib is statically linked by upstream's Windows FFmpeg build, so its exact build version is not identified by the archive; continue verifying provenance when the bundle changes.
